command: python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . (Feature Mixer harness)

tests.name: tests.test_journey.DependencyTests.test_app_imports_only_the_standard_library
tests.expected: every import in the fileshare package is the standard library or the package itself

tests.name: tests.test_journey.JourneyTests.test_upload_preview_share_open_revoke
tests.expected: register, upload, list, preview, share with a password, recipient opens and downloads, owner revokes, link dies

tests.name: tests.test_v1_core.AccountsTests.test_account_password_is_salted_pbkdf2
tests.expected: account passwords are stored as pbkdf2_sha256 with a per-user salt, never in plain text

tests.name: tests.test_v1_core.AccountsTests.test_register_login_logout
tests.expected: register sets an http-only session cookie; logout ends it; login with the right password restores it

tests.name: tests.test_v1_core.AccountsTests.test_session_expires
tests.expected: a session older than 7 days answers 401

tests.name: tests.test_v1_core.AccountsTests.test_wrong_password_and_duplicate_username
tests.expected: wrong password is 401 bad_credentials; a taken username is 409; short passwords are 400

tests.name: tests.test_v1_core.FallbackPreviewTests.test_other_types_have_no_preview
tests.expected: .pdf, .zip and extensionless files preview as kind none with the reason

tests.name: tests.test_v1_core.ListTests.test_each_user_sees_only_their_files
tests.expected: two users each list only their own files, newest first

tests.name: tests.test_v1_core.ListTests.test_empty_list
tests.expected: a new user gets an empty list

tests.name: tests.test_v1_core.PlatformTests.test_invalid_json_is_400
tests.expected: a malformed JSON body answers 400 invalid_json

tests.name: tests.test_v1_core.PlatformTests.test_pages_and_unknown_routes
tests.expected: / and /s/<token> serve HTML; unknown routes are 404 and wrong methods 405, both in the JSON error shape

tests.name: tests.test_v1_core.PlatformTests.test_schema_created_from_empty_with_foreign_keys
tests.expected: every table exists after start and foreign keys cascade from files

tests.name: tests.test_v1_core.TextPreviewTests.test_preview_of_someone_elses_file_is_404
tests.expected: previewing another user's file answers 404 not_found

tests.name: tests.test_v1_core.TextPreviewTests.test_text_preview_first_20_lines
tests.expected: .txt, .md and .csv (any case) preview as kind text with at most 20 lines

tests.name: tests.test_v1_core.TextPreviewTests.test_text_preview_replaces_invalid_utf8
tests.expected: undecodable bytes become replacement characters instead of an error

tests.name: tests.test_v1_core.UploadTests.test_file_endpoints_need_sign_in
tests.expected: every owner endpoint answers 401 with the JSON error shape when nobody is signed in

tests.name: tests.test_v1_core.UploadTests.test_upload_limit_is_10_mb
tests.expected: exactly 10485760 bytes is accepted; 10485761 is 413 file_too_large and nothing is stored

tests.name: tests.test_v1_core.UploadTests.test_upload_rejects_oversize_content_length_before_reading
tests.expected: a Content-Length over the limit is refused with 413 without reading the body

tests.name: tests.test_v1_core.UploadTests.test_upload_returns_file
tests.expected: 201 with id, name, size and a guessed content type

tests.name: tests.test_v1_core.UploadTests.test_upload_validation
tests.expected: missing or unsafe names are 400 invalid_name; a missing Content-Length is 411

tests.name: tests.test_v2_sharing.CreateLinkTests.test_custom_expiry_and_validation
tests.expected: positive hours are honoured; 0, negative, text, booleans and null are 400 invalid_expiry

tests.name: tests.test_v2_sharing.CreateLinkTests.test_default_expiry_is_24_hours
tests.expected: a link without expires_in_hours expires exactly 24 h after creation and has a 16-byte url-safe token

tests.name: tests.test_v2_sharing.CreateLinkTests.test_expired_link_is_404
tests.expected: a link opens up to its expiry second and answers 404 not_found after it

tests.name: tests.test_v2_sharing.CreateLinkTests.test_only_the_owner_can_create_links
tests.expected: another user creating a link to alice's file gets 404 and no link is stored; unknown files are 404

tests.name: tests.test_v2_sharing.OpenLinkTests.test_anonymous_download
tests.expected: the content route returns the exact bytes as an attachment for non-image types

tests.name: tests.test_v2_sharing.OpenLinkTests.test_anonymous_open_shows_metadata_and_preview
tests.expected: without a session the link returns name, size, content type and the text preview

tests.name: tests.test_v2_sharing.OpenLinkTests.test_link_gives_access_to_one_file_only
tests.expected: a link holder cannot list the owner's files or reach other files through owner routes

tests.name: tests.test_v2_sharing.OpenLinkTests.test_unknown_token_is_404
tests.expected: an unknown token answers 404 with the same message as an expired one

tests.name: tests.test_v3_should.DeleteTests.test_cannot_delete_someone_elses_file
tests.expected: bob deleting alice's file gets 404 and alice still has it

tests.name: tests.test_v3_should.DeleteTests.test_delete_removes_file_and_its_links
tests.expected: 204; the file leaves the list, its bytes are gone, and its share link answers 404

tests.name: tests.test_v3_should.ImagePreviewTests.test_image_preview_through_a_share_link
tests.expected: a shared image previews with a link-scoped URL that serves the image without a session

tests.name: tests.test_v3_should.ImagePreviewTests.test_image_preview_url_serves_the_image
tests.expected: .png/.jpg/.gif preview as kind image; the URL serves the bytes inline with an image content type

tests.name: tests.test_v3_should.ImagePreviewTests.test_svg_and_html_are_downloads_not_inline
tests.expected: types outside png/jpg/gif (svg, html) get no image preview and are served as attachments

tests.name: tests.test_v3_should.PasswordLinkTests.test_invalid_password_value
tests.expected: an empty or non-string password is 400 invalid_password

tests.name: tests.test_v3_should.PasswordLinkTests.test_password_required_and_checked
tests.expected: no password is 403 password_required, a wrong one 403 wrong_password, the right one opens metadata and content

tests.name: tests.test_v3_should.PasswordLinkTests.test_password_stored_as_salted_slow_hash
tests.expected: the stored hash is pbkdf2_sha256 with a salt, not ShareLink's unsalted SHA-256 hex, and two links with the same password differ

tests.name: tests.test_v3_should.RevokeTests.test_other_user_cannot_revoke
tests.expected: bob revoking alice's link gets 404 and the link keeps working

tests.name: tests.test_v3_should.RevokeTests.test_owner_revokes_link
tests.expected: 204, after which the link answers 404; revoking again is 404
